title: Phase oscillator networks with multiple and state-dependent delays: A framework for exploring white matter plasticity in neurodynamics
summary: Network science is increasingly focused on how node dynamics influence emergent phenomena such as oscillations, waves, chimeras, and turbulence. In oscillatory systems modeled by networks of coupled ordinary differential equations (ODEs), a common approach is to reduce the system to phase variables. When understanding how network delays shape emergent properties, the delays are often absorbed in the reduced description as a phase shift. The reduced system is a set of ODEs that loses some information about the full delay differential equation (DDE) system. We adopt a less restrictive approach…
